title: fix(showcase): notify slots on an optional user field complete the run when it is empty
body:
domain:server#5 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5oc56xChD6Wrc4cGSt

<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XRzFmxNqPSgstp8DRYyn2mP)_

Fixes #29028

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:showcase 里 8 个流程的通知在负责人/经办人字段为空时也能跑完,外加预算审批流程的启动条件先判空再比较。关于记录本身的提醒(任务完成、项目结项、并行通知、紧急任务的系统写入、嵌套循环提醒)改发给组织所有者(`role:owner`);只对经办人本人说的话("你被分配了"、"请更新任务"、"任务快到期")没有经办人就直接结束,不发。
- 为什么改:`has(FIELD) ? FIELD : null` 在空字段上返回 null(触发记录上空字段是 null,`has()` 为真),通知没有收件人就让整个运行失败,谁也收不到。参考应用教的正是这种无效写法。
- 风险与回滚:只动示例应用(私有包,不发布),不碰引擎、CEL 和通知节点,通知节点"至少一个收件人"的拒收不变。回滚即 revert。
- 先看:`examples/app-showcase/src/automation/flows/index.ts`(三个 `has_assignee` 决策节点、`role:owner` 兜底、紧急任务的嵌套三元式);新测试 `examples/app-showcase/test/notify-recipient-optional-fields.test.ts`;从 #29018 测试抽出的共用 `test/showcase-flow-run.testkit.ts`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/example-showcase exec vitest run test/notify-recipient-optional-fields.test.ts`,预期 `Tests 20 passed (20)`。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

`examples/app-showcase/src/automation/flows/index.ts`, one row per measured notify slot (an empty field, the row as stored, on base `6b3ba82c`):

| Flow | Node | Field | Base | Reading | Fix |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `showcase_task_completed` | `notify` | `record.assignee` | fails | a notice about the record | `isBlank(record.assignee) ? 'role:owner' : record.assignee` |
| `showcase_task_assigned_notify` | `notify_assignee` | `record.assignee` | fails (unassigning a task) | "you have been assigned": assignee only | `has_assignee` decision, `!isBlank(record.assignee)` edge, `isDefault` edge to `end` |
| `showcase_task_follow_up` | `remind` | `record.assignee` | fails (after the wait resumes) | "please update its status": assignee only | `has_assignee` decision after the wait, same shape |
| `showcase_project_closure` | `notify_owner` | `record.owner` | fails (after sign-off) | the decision needs a reader | `isBlank(record.owner) ? 'role:owner' : record.owner` |
| `showcase_batch_reminders` | `send_reminder` | `task.owner` | completes | each iteration sits in its `try_catch`, by design | none |
| `showcase_fan_out_notify` | `notify_owner` | `record.assignee` | fails (the failed branch fails the block, the Slack post with it) | a notice about the record | `isBlank(record.assignee) ? 'role:owner' : record.assignee` |
| `showcase_nested_fan_out_reminders` | `notify_owner` | `task.owner` | fails (ends the sweep) | loop rows are caller data, so the key may be absent | `has(task.owner) && !isBlank(task.owner) ? task.owner : 'role:owner'` |
| `showcase_nested_fan_out_reminders` | `notify_watcher` | `task.watcher` | fails | same | same spelling on `task.watcher` |
| `showcase_task_due_reminder` | `remind_owner` | `record.assignee` | fails | "your task is due": assignee only | `has_assignee` decision, same shape |
| `showcase_urgent_task_alert` | `alert` | `record.assignee` | completes on a user's write (`current_user` is the second recipient); fails on a system write | a notice about the record | `!isBlank(record.assignee) ? record.assignee : current_user == null ? 'role:owner' : null` (a user's write still alerts that user, unchanged) |

- `showcase_project_escalation`: #29018 left no `has()` slot.
- The guarded notifies after a `has_assignee` decision read plain `record.assignee`, as #29018's `alert_owner` does. The notify node's required-recipient refusal is unchanged.
- Start conditions: `showcase_budget_approval`'s `budget > 100000 && budget != previous.budget` faults (`no such overload`) when a budget is cleared (`null` against a previous value); it is now `budget != null && budget > 100000 && budget != previous.budget`. `showcase_committee_quorum`'s `total_amount >= 5000` is fine: the sum summary stores `0` on a report with no lines, measured.
- Field writes left alone (order ruling 3): `showcase_task_completed` `summarize.inputs.priority`; `showcase_task_done_notify_owner` `call_notify.input.ownerId`; `showcase_inbound_task_webhook` `create_task.fields.assignee` and `.project`. Writing `null` is the correct answer there.
- `examples/app-showcase/test/showcase-flow-run.testkit.ts` (new): #29018's harness moved out of its test file, unchanged in behaviour, so both files share one kit (order: reuse it, no second harness). `project-escalation-optional-fields.test.ts` now imports it.

## Tests

- New `examples/app-showcase/test/notify-recipient-optional-fields.test.ts`, 20 cases on the shared kit: per fixed flow an empty-field case (asserts the stored row reads `null` first, the run completes, and the fallback audience or no notify) and a filled-field control that still notifies the field's user; plus the batch-reminders, quorum and urgent user-write readings that were already fine.
  - `showcase_project_closure` runs with a stand-in `showcase_closure_signoff` that decides at once (same name and variables), because the real one waits on a manager approval; the parent flow and its notify are real.
  - `showcase_task_follow_up` is run, parks at its timer wait, and is resumed with `automation.resume(runId)`.
- **Red on base** (flows file at `6b3ba82c`, tests kept): 9 failed / 11 passed. Failing nodes: `notify`, `notify_assignee`, `remind`, `notify_owner`, `fan_out` (branch `notify_owner`), `remind_owner`, `alert` (system write), `fan_out_audiences` (branch `notify_owner`), each `notify: at least one recipient is required …`; and `condition failed to evaluate as CEL` (budget). Restored: blob `9f537eab` equal to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- **Ablations** (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, each anchor hit once, each restored to blob `9f537eab` with `git diff HEAD` empty), one guard per fixed flow, each run with `-t FLOW`: task_completed fallback → `record.assignee`: 1 failed; task_assigned edge → `true`: 1 failed; follow_up edge → `true`: 1 failed; closure fallback → `record.owner`: 1 failed; fan_out fallback → `record.assignee`: 1 failed; nested owner → `task.owner`: 1 failed; due_reminder edge → `true`: 1 failed; urgent → `… : null`: 1 failed; budget start guard dropped: 1 failed.
- No `dist/` on the path: the tests import the flows from `src`.

## Acceptance notes

- `pnpm validate` still warns `flow-loop-body-uncontained` on `showcase_nested_fan_out_reminders` (no `try_catch` in the loop body). That is the flow's deliberate shape (its docblock: containment would retag the branch steps); with the fallback an empty recipient no longer fails a row, so the warning's failure mode no longer comes from these slots.
- `showcase_task_done_notify_owner` hands `ownerId: has(record.project.owner) ? record.project.owner : null` to the `showcase_notify_owner` subflow, whose notify then has no recipient on a project with no owner. Left alone per order ruling 3 (named as a field write); not measured here.

## Verification

Every run here and above is on `fb792a78` (branch base `6b3ba82c`), each test command under `os-verify-lock` (`VERDICT command-exit 0`). The head `7538f3e3` merges `origin/main` on top; that merge changes nothing under `examples/app-showcase/`.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/example-showcase test`: Test Files 44 passed (44); Tests 538 passed (538). Then `pnpm validate`: exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/example-showcase typecheck`: exit 0.
- `eslint --no-inline-config` on the four touched files: exit 0.
- Derived gates (`dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`, derived on this diff): NOT MEASURED locally, reason: the maintainer asked to wrap up; CI runs the families.
- Changeset: none. `@objectstack/example-showcase` is `"private": true`, so nothing here ships; `skip-changeset` rides the create.
